<Heading

>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/tasks/{id}/lease-renewals"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Pushes out a task's lease expiry so a station still actively working it doesn't lose the claim to the automatic expiry sweep (`POST /task-lease-expirations`). Only the station that currently owns the claim may renew it. Idempotent in effect: repeated calls simply keep extending the same lease.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-supplied key, 1-128 printable ASCII characters (a UUID minted once per LOGICAL submit; a retry reuses it, a new user action mints a new one). Required on every POST: a missing key is `400 idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one `400 idempotency-key-invalid`. The key is global to the service: a retry with the same method, path and body replays the stored answer (status, body and `Location`) with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` and runs nothing; the same key with a different method, path or body is `409 idempotency-key-reused`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"pattern":"^[ -~]+$","example":"6f1c2a3e-9b1d-4c1a-8f0e-2d5b7c9a1e44"}},{"name":"id","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The task id, as returned by `POST /tasks` or a task-claims response.","schema":{"type":"string","example":"20260101T120000.000000000"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>

  body={{"required":true,"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","required":["stationId"],"properties":{"stationId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Must match the station that currently owns the active claim.
